test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I am glad I ______ my friend’s invitation to dinner as I met many old friends there.
solution: The correct answer is '**accepted**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Accept**__** (verb)**- **to agree to take something that somebody offers you.** (दी गई वस्‍तु को) स्‍वीकार या ग्रहण करना __ • ​​ E.g.__- Please accept this small gift. Hence, the correct answer is '**accepted**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Admit**__** ****(verb)**- **to allow somebody/something to enter; to take somebody into a place.** (प्रवेश करने देना; भर्ती करना) __ • E.g.__- He was **admitted** to the hospital with suspected appendicitis. **​ ** • __**Deny**__** (verb)**- **to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit or accept something.**(किसी बात से इनकार करना; किसी बात को नकारना) __ • ​E.g.__- In court, he **denied** all the charges. • ​__Allow__ (verb)- **to give permission for somebody/something to do something.** (कुछ करने की अनुमति देना) __ • E.g.__- Photography is not allowed inside the temple.​** ** **​ ** 9f:T1432, The correct answer is '**Divide**'.
